verdict.rationale: The Search API returns ranked web results as structured data with extracted page text and query-relevant snippets, explicitly meant for your own model. Result count is controllable via max_results, but sizing of content for an LLM context budget is not documented. missing for 10: documented per-result or total token/character budget controls for context sizing, explicit RAG-oriented chunking or ranking guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of context quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get results sized and ranked for direct use as LLM context in a RAG pipeline

citations.quote: Perplexity's Search API returns real-time, ranked web results as structured data, with controls for domains, languages, regions, and extracted content.
Search: ranked web results with extracted page text for your own model.
web search and query-relevant page snippets from your terminal or coding agent
Use the Search API when you need raw results for your own processing.
